Source contracts: setupplaywright.sh

setupplaywright.sh

Shell · Tier B

Install Chromium for the shipped UI regression workflow.

Usage

Run after install.sh has created the root .venv and installed Playwright.

Inputs

Uses .venv/bin/python from this checkout; no script-specific CLI options.

Side effects

Downloads Chromium into Playwright browser storage; creates no runtime browser profile.

Cleanup

Exits with the installer status; does not start a browser or Agent service.
